title: DEC-244: FE03 refetch readings from wave 8 (2026-10-30)
text:
- **Problem**: lanes web8a/web8b implemented the DEC-242 refetch cells and asked for readings.
- **Options considered**: per item, the stricter cell vs a reading consistent with FE03 and BE00 idempotency.
- **Decision** (root, owner may override): (1) related-content 'success refetch' re-reads the saved rule and adopts its entry token as the next version; (2) a 409 IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH (the same key with a different body) is not a version conflict and triggers no refetch — the person sends a new request; (3) an unknown-outcome retry is the identical request under its key and If-Match and never adopts the version the reconciling read saw (a replay must be byte-identical); (4) the related-content 'Check again' control after a read that cannot verify is the only non-dead-end way to keep 'reconciled before any retry' and is accepted; template/pattern designers show no list, so their success refetch is N/A; term 422 reasons with no FE03-named field stay summary-level (BOUNDARY); the locale 422 copy must say the locale is not supported for this content type (DEC-230) — a copy fix in the next web round.
- **Downstream**: AC-271 limitations; review V19; the locale copy fix.
- **Reversibility**: High

title: DEC-245: Refutation-8 rulings on the FE03 refetch cells, AC-294 and stand-in producers (2026-10-30)
text:
- **Problem**: refute8 section 9 asked for seven rulings before the wave-8 citations can be applied.
- **Options considered**: per item, the stricter reading vs the narrower one.
- **Decision** (root, owner may override): (1) registry-digest 409 in the template create and pattern designers gets a context refetch through the existing browser route (V19 M2, lane web8a), so the three pinned 'reads nothing' rows are rewritten, not kept; (2) a NEW vocabulary's 409 and unknown outcome are BOUNDARY — BE03c defines no read by key for an unsaved vocabulary; (3) the vocabulary designer's 422 with no reason and no field is BOUNDARY like the term action's (DEC-244); (4) the composition islands hold a retry after a reconciling read that cannot verify, like the template, locale and related islands (defect for lane web8b); (5) AC-271's already-cited clauses that claim every family (c10, c11) are universal: uncited until every cell is proven; (6) AC-294 'invisible/foreign definition' means a definition (content type, template), not a relation target — part 3 stays uncited unless a definition lever is driven; 'archived' stays open until an archive writer exists; (7) a stand-in producer is acceptable evidence only when it takes exactly the production path's locks (U1 yes; U3, which locks FOR UPDATE where the CMS-03B-20 executor takes FOR SHARE, no).
- **Downstream**: apply8; lane web8b composition retry hold; AC-271/AC-294 limitations.
- **Reversibility**: High
